messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — handing Ember (MID-MKT) to CS. Signed 2024-10-01. Main asks: SSO via Okta, private VPC, and high-throughput embeddings. Renewal Q3 2025 (early churn signal: slow onboarding). Prod key usage estimate 1.2M tokens/day after week 4.

alex_cs: Thanks @maria_sales. I'll own onboarding. Quick Q: do they have SSO cert ready? Who's the technical contact?

maria_sales: Technical contact is Ravi Patel (ravi@ember.ai). SSO cert in progress (Okta). They want dedicated capacity if latency < 150ms. Also asked about private deployment timeline.

alex_cs: Kicking off enablement playbook. I'll schedule kickoff with Ravi and set up shared runbook. Owners: alex_cs (onboarding), jon_eng (connector / VPC), tess_support (post-go support).

jon_eng: I can take VPC + connector. Need network CIDR and SSO metadata. Can we get AWS account ID and contact? Also: will they need HSM/KMS?

maria_sales: AWS account ID: 9876543210. HSM not required initially. Ravi will send Okta metadata and CIDR today. I'll CC him in follow-up.

tess_support: I'll create a post-go support rotation and runbook entry. Also want a canary alert for embedding latency >200ms.

alex_cs: Action items:
- maria_sales: Intro email to Ravi + track Okta metadata (due EOD)
- jon_eng: Provision VPC + initial connector (ticket INF-4523)
- tess_support: Support runbook + alert (ticket SUP-3377)
- alex_cs: Kickoff call + success criteria doc (due 48h)

jon_eng: Created INF-4523, assigned to me. ETA 3 business days. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4523

tess_support: Created SUP-3377, added pager rotation. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-3377

maria_sales: Intro email sent to Ravi, pasted Okta SAML metadata in the thread.

alex_cs: Got the metadata, starting config. Will post a short checklist when done. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Deploy job started for connector-provisioner (build #4127)

jon_eng: Connector provisioned in staging. Running smoke tests:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.ember.redwood.internal/health
```
Healthy. Scheduling canary in prod next Monday.

alex_cs: Great. I'll update the onboarding board and set renewal playbook flags (renewal at risk -> medium) — noting they might expand if latency or SSO slips.

tess_support: Noted. I'll prepare a short onboarding feedback form to capture integration blockers.

maria_sales: Thanks team — cc @ravi.patel for visibility. Will check back after kickoff call.

alex_cs: Closing the loop: kickoff scheduled Wed 10am PT. Owners and tickets are set. Will post any blockers here.
